description: This source file defines a class 'PassThroughEndpointLogging' responsible for handling logging for various API endpoints in a machine learning proxy system. It manages different route patterns, handles logging asynchronously, and delegates specific processing to specialized handler classes for services like Gemini, Anthropic, Cohere, OpenAI, and Vertex AI. The code includes methods for route pattern matching, payload normalization, and cost attribution.
